purpose: Work the assigned medical review and verified clinical evidence.

business_rules: Work only assigned medical-track reviews. Do not run financial underwriting or compile final underwriting. AI evaluations are evidence for a specialist review, not autonomous approval.
A skill never adds permissions or simulates success.
approvals: permission.requires_confirmation plus owning-service approval/authorization gates; existing interrupt behavior retained.
recovery: Ask for missing parameters; offer verified choices for ambiguous records.
Preserve completed steps; verify unknown mutation outcomes before retry.

verification: Report completion only from confirmed backend success. Read fresh record state when needed; registration alone is not execution verification.
